# Godot 节点式状态机知识图谱

## Overview

```mermaid
flowchart TD
    A1["State (base class)"] -->|inherits| B1["Node"]
    A2["StateMachine (manager)"] -->|inherits| B1
    A1 --> C1["Signal: switch_state(target_state)"]
    A1 --> D1["enter_state()"]
    A1 --> D2["exit_state()"]
    A1 --> D3["update(delta)"]
    A1 --> D4["physics_update(delta)"]
    A2 --> E1["export var initial_state : State"]
    A2 --> E2["var active_state : State"]
    A2 --> F1["ready(): connect child switch_state -> change_state"]
    A2 --> F2["change_state(new_state)"]
    F2 -->|calls| D2["exit_state() of active_state"]
    F2 -->|sets| E2["active_state = new_state"]
    F2 -->|calls| D1["enter_state() of new_state"]
    subgraph G[State Instances]
        G1["IdleState"]
        G2["MoveState"]
    end
    A2 --> G1
    A2 --> G2
    G1 --> C1
    G2 --> C1
```

## State Script API

```mermaid
flowchart LR
    S["State (extends Node)"] --> Sig["signal switch_state(target_state)"]
    S --> Ent["func enter_state()"]
    S --> Ext["func exit_state()"]
    S --> Upd["func update(delta)"]
    S --> Phy["func physics_update(delta)"]
    Sig -->|emitted to| SM["StateMachine"]
    SM -->|calls| Ent
    SM -->|calls| Ext
    SM -->|calls| Upd
    SM -->|calls| Phy
```

## State Transition Process

```mermaid
flowchart TD
    I["IdleState.update(delta)"] --> Cond["if input_vector != Vector2.ZERO"]
    Cond --> Emit["emit switch_state(move_state)"]
    Emit --> SM["StateMachine.change_state(new_state)"]
    SM --> Check["if new_state == active_state"]
    Check -->|yes| Skip["return (no change)"]
    Check -->|no| Exit["active_state.exit_state()"]
    Exit --> Set["active_state = new_state"]
    Set --> Enter["active_state.enter_state()"]
    Enter --> Done["state switched"]
```

## Adding & Linking New States

```mermaid
flowchart LR
    C1["Create MoveState.gd (inherits State)"]
    C2["Add export var idle_state : State in MoveState"]
    C3["Assign IdleState node to idle_state export"]
    C4["MoveState.update(delta)"]
    C4 --> CondMove["if input_vector == Vector2.ZERO"]
    CondMove --> EmitSwitch["emit switch_state(idle_state)"]
    EmitSwitch --> SM["StateMachine.change_state(idle_state)"]
    C5["In IdleState export var move_state : State"]
    C5 --> AssignMove["Assign MoveState node to move_state export"]
    C6["IdleState.update(delta)"]
    C6 --> CondIdle["if input_vector != Vector2.ZERO"]
    CondIdle --> EmitSwitchIdle["emit switch_state(move_state)"]
    EmitSwitchIdle --> SM
```

diagrams.code:
flowchart LR
    S["State (extends Node)"] --> Sig["signal switch_state(target_state)"]
    S --> Ent["func enter_state()"]
    S --> Ext["func exit_state()"]
    S --> Upd["func update(delta)"]
    S --> Phy["func physics_update(delta)"]
    Sig -->|emitted to| SM["StateMachine"]
    SM -->|calls| Ent
    SM -->|calls| Ext
    SM -->|calls| Upd
    SM -->|calls| Phy

diagrams.title: State Transition Process
diagrams.code:
flowchart TD
    I["IdleState.update(delta)"] --> Cond["if input_vector != Vector2.ZERO"]
    Cond --> Emit["emit switch_state(move_state)"]
    Emit --> SM["StateMachine.change_state(new_state)"]
    SM --> Check["if new_state == active_state"]
    Check -->|yes| Skip["return (no change)"]
    Check -->|no| Exit["active_state.exit_state()"]
    Exit --> Set["active_state = new_state"]
    Set --> Enter["active_state.enter_state()"]
    Enter --> Done["state switched"]

diagrams.title: Adding & Linking New States
diagrams.code:
flowchart LR
    C1["Create MoveState.gd (inherits State)"]
    C2["Add export var idle_state : State in MoveState"]
    C3["Assign IdleState node to idle_state export"]
    C4["MoveState.update(delta)"]
    C4 --> CondMove["if input_vector == Vector2.ZERO"]
    CondMove --> EmitSwitch["emit switch_state(idle_state)"]
    EmitSwitch --> SM["StateMachine.change_state(idle_state)"]
    C5["In IdleState export var move_state : State"]
    C5 --> AssignMove["Assign MoveState node to move_state export"]
    C6["IdleState.update(delta)"]
    C6 --> CondIdle["if input_vector != Vector2.ZERO"]
    CondIdle --> EmitSwitchIdle["emit switch_state(move_state)"]
    EmitSwitchIdle --> SM
